record.title: Select a whole-sequence ADC hypothesis from the captured software inputs
record.intent: Instantiate the static candidate or isolate a specific missing input before admitting another bounded experiment.
requirements: Evaluate whether the snapshot selects a complete 97 100 or 244 write candidate with two readbacks, and separate software operands from physical behavior.

If inputs are complete prefer whole-sequence prediction and selective falsification through the routine return with an explicitly synthetic readback hypothesis and no claim of acquisition; otherwise name the precise unresolved dependency.
Reconcile unexpected architectural evidence before continuation. Draft plan inspect admit against expected revision and commit and push any successor batch before implementation or execution.
acceptance: The evidence-supported successor or genuine blocking condition is explicitly recorded and committed.

evidence.continuation: docs/research/adc-input-health-routing.md and admitted two-task batch preserve the whole-sequence static-first objective. This reconciliation updates dependency observations only; no stock result or successor device model is claimed.
